description: Internal rate of return for an equal-period cash flow series, solved by deterministic bisection over a declared rate bracket with declared tolerance and iteration cap. Never Newton/derivative-based, so no float-drift nondeterminism. Reports whether the bracket contained a sign change and whether the search converged.

output.note: IRR solved by deterministic bisection over the declared [bracket_lo, bracket_hi] rate bracket with declared tolerance and iteration cap — never Newton/derivative-based, so no float-drift nondeterminism. Requires a sign change in NPV(bracket_lo)..NPV(bracket_hi); widen the bracket if bracket_valid is false. Equal-period cash flows only (index 0..n-1); for irregular dated flows use XIRR.
output.regulatory_basis: Standard internal rate of return, textbook definition (root of NPV as a function of the discount rate)
